arguments.subject: Re: [TCK-4827] URGENT — why am I being logged out every time I switch machines??
arguments.body:
Hi Maya,

I'm really sorry for the disruption and the repeated sign-outs just as you're trying to get your work done — I fully understand how frustrating and unacceptable that is, especially under a deadline.

This is not an intended policy or a payment-method device binding issue (those affect billing actions only). Persistent sign-in sessions across multiple devices are fully supported for Pro customers using Google SSO, and you should not be logged out automatically when switching between machines.

What you are experiencing sounds like a possible bug or a backend issue affecting your account sessions. I will escalate your case to our human support engineers immediately so they can prioritize investigation, as this could require server-side log review. You will get a response from our team as soon as possible.

If you’re willing, please also share:
- The operating system and browser(s) or Cursor desktop version (Help → About) used on each device
- Whether the sign-out happens after a fixed time or only after using another device
- Any recent security-related events (password or account changes on Google)

Thank you for your patience — I will make sure you are kept updated on this. 

Best,
Lyra Support Bot

(P.S. For urgent escalation, you can always email support@cursor.com with these details as well.)

arguments.subject: Escalation: [TCK-4827] URGENT — why am I being logged out every time I switch machines??
arguments.body:
Internal note: Escalation required. Pro plan customer Maya Reyes reports being logged out of Cursor every time she signs in on another device, across three machines (MacBook Pro, Linux desktop, remote Linux dev box) using Google SSO. This is a new issue; she reports it has never happened before and is losing work-in-progress. Symptoms do not match documented account or billing policy (device binding covers billing actions only). Issue likely requires backend/session log review for root cause.

Customer deadline and frustration level high — please prioritize.

(Ticket ID: TCK-4827)

arguments.subject: Re: [TCK-4815] Invoice PDF won't download
arguments.body:
Hi Daniel,

Thank you for reaching out and letting us know about the trouble with the invoice download.

The spinning download button usually means the PDF is still building on our server or there may be a browser cache or extension interfering with the download.

Could you please try the following steps:

1. Refresh the page and try the download again.
2. Try opening the invoice download page in a private/incognito window (this disables most extensions and clears the cache).
3. If the PDF still won't download, let us know if you see any error messages or if the behavior changes in incognito mode.

If none of these steps resolve the problem, reply here and I’ll escalate your ticket to our human support team for direct help.

Thank you for your patience!

Best,
Lyra Support Bot
